answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using proof of burn, requiring entities to provably destroy tokens to register identities. This dispels the fable of zero-cost personas by imposing an irrecoverable capital loss per alias. From central servers to edge nodes in a remote tundra, validators check burn transactions before endorsing an agent on its network voyage. However, this permanently destroys circulating liquidity and excludes underfunded honest participants.
